name: vc-kb
description: The Virto Commerce knowledge base tool. `kb` extracts the DERIVED plane (REST + GraphQL contracts) from a running deployment, and resolves questions against that plus a written EXPERIENTIAL plane of observations agents captured while working. A CLI, deliberately not an MCP server: an MCP tool's schema sits in context on every turn, and this one is consulted a handful of times per run. Zero runtime dependencies, Node >= 20, no install step. It reads and writes a base (VirtoCommerce/vc-knowledge) whose location is DECLARED, never discovered: --base, then KB_BASE, then knowledgeBase.path in project-profile.json, which /project-init writes when it clones the base into the project. Ships hooks/arrive.mjs UNWIRED on purpose — see PORT.md.
